$comment: Read from the SIA chart set AD 2 LFLT (AIP France, chart dated 2023-08-10): the reporting points come from the coordinates table of the chart,
the notes from the English column of its text pages, both read by a script and checked (each point lies within 80 NM of the aerodrome).
Only what the chart prints is recorded; nothing is deduced. Services, frequencies, elevation, position, magnetic variation and runways
were first extracted automatically from the chart text. Drawings (circuit, routes, radials) are not read.
The charts themselves are (c) SIA and are not redistributed. Flight simulation only: never use for real navigation.

A "fr" object holds the French column of the same chart for the notes, copied as printed and never translated: a French note sits at the index of its English twin and is left empty when the twin could not be paired with certainty.

The reporting points are in French: "location" is the name printed in the French column of the chart, copied and not translated, and "purpose" is written in French; a point whose French name could not be read has no "location". Only "spoken.en" is English: the name the English phraseology says over the radio.
name: Montluçon - Domérat

source.extraction: chart text, table and English column read by script, checked
source.frenchExtraction: French column of the chart text, read by script and paired with the English sentences

notes: AD reserved for: home-based ACFT; ACFT exceptionnally authorized by AD operator.
For ACFT, pilot must have been indicated able to use AD by an instructor (or hold an instructor qualification).
If wind blowing from E possibility of high downdrafts QFU 109°.
Avoid overflying inhabited areas.
ARRIVALS / DEPARTURES FROM EAST: Proceed via N or S point for noise abatement.
Preferred QFU 289° due to environment.
LDG RWY 29: Do not go beyond the Cher river on base leg.
TKOF RWY 11 prohibited.
TWY B one-way (from RWY intersection to A).
Take-off RWY 29: do not turn before the bridge on the RN 145 and avoid flying over Domérat.
As per protocol.
AD réservé : aux ACFT basés ; aux ACFT exceptionnellement autorisés par l'exploitant d'aérodrome.
Pour les avions, le pilote doit de plus avoir été reconnu apte à utiliser l'AD par un instructeur (ou détenir une qualification d'instructeur).
Par vent d'Est possibilité de rabattants au QFU 109°.
Éviter au maximum le survol des zones habitées.
ARRIVEES / DEPARTS SECTEUR EST : Cause nuisances procéder via les points N ou S.
QFU 289° préférentiel cause environnement.
Atterrissage RWY 29 : Ne pas dépasser le Cher en étape de base.
Décollage RWY 11 interdit.
TWY B à sens unique (de l'intersection piste vers A).
Décollage RWY 29 : ne pas virer avant le pont sur la RN 145 et éviter le survol de la ville de Domérat.
Selon protocole.
